instruction: Configure spam filtering in Thunderbird for the support-desk@outlook.com account, ensuring suspected spam is moved to the junk folder, without requiring my email password at this time.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because setting up email filtering rules in Thunderbird requires a properly authenticated email account with access to mailbox folders and server communication. Without providing credentials and completing account authentication, Thunderbird cannot establish the necessary connection to create or apply filtering rules. This is analogous to the original task's attempt to configure partial account functionality without full setup.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - instruction contains fundamental contradiction
Instruction explicitly states user won't provide password ('not ready to enter my email password yet')
Setting up spam filtering rules requires authenticated email account with server access
Without authentication, Thunderbird cannot access mailbox folders or configure server-side filters
Evaluator correctly uses 'infeasible' function for impossible tasks
Metadata explanation accurately describes why task cannot be completed
